semantics.sequence: strictly increasing Lib-produced sequence; gaps make overwritten or missed samples observable
semantics.freshness_mask: bit set only when the Lib refreshed the corresponding generic Host resource for this frame; an unset bit means the value is a carried-forward cache, not a new external observation
semantics.flags: backend/platform/provider identity is deliberately absent; zero today and reserved for backend-independent frame semantics only
semantics.total_memory: cold/static Lib metadata; intentionally excluded from every hot frame
